'''Vette's padded jacket''' was an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]]. It was [[gray]] in color with a number of [[brown]] leather straps and pads.
